  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages.

  • Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience across multiple business and corporate functions.

  • Proven success recruiting for functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, Consulting, CEO Office, or other business-critical roles.

  • Demonstrated ability to hire senior, niche, and difficult-to-fill positions across multiple markets.

  • Strong expertise in sourcing passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, talent mapping, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence hiring decisions and challenge hiring assumptions when necessary.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, organizational design discussions, and workforce planning initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, consulting firms, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality hires across multiple business functions and regions.

  • Builds sustainable talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill business roles.

  • Becomes a trusted advisor to business leaders and hiring managers.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Exposure to global hiring across multiple countries and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership on critical business hiring initiatives.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to building and scaling world-class teams.

raw.description:
Videogame Studio Accountant & Administrator

Seismic Squirrel LLC

Job Title: Videogame Studio Accountant & Administrator

The Role: Provide accounting, administrative, and operational support for a growing videogame studio.

The Game: A vehicular RPG videogame set in an alternate history 1930s New York.

Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in a small-business accounting and administrative role.

Location: USA (Remote) – Must reside within the UTC-4 to UTC-8 timezones.

Team Size: 24

Pay: $36 - $46 USD per hour – Depends on skills and experience.

Job Type: Contract-to-Hire

Job Overview

This is a multi-hat role, requiring a variety of business skills and experience. On one hand, we need a careful, detail-oriented accountant and bookkeeper, on the other hand someone resourceful at administration and operations with a clear talent for organization and coordination, someone adept at logical and systemic thinking with a collaborative spirit, excellent communication skills, and an enthusiasm for videogames and the videogame industry. The ideal candidate enjoys working with management and a team of talented creatives, with a drive to help us to efficiently create great products.

The ideal candidate communicates effectively in a small cross-functional remote team environment. They bring a passion for working within a product development environment, having a collaborative spirit and an enthusiasm for supporting a team of creative individuals.

This is a remote, contract-to-hire position which requires regular collaboration online during our core work hours (9:30 AM – 5:30 PM Pacific), attending relevant team meetings. Occasional calls during late evenings and early mornings should be expected.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the USA. The option to convert to full-time employee may be available, depending on applicant's location, skills, performance, aptitude, and project needs. H-1B transfers and sponsorships are not available at this time.

The Company

Seismic Squirrel is a close-knit, fully remote videogame studio with a team spread across the USA and Canada. We are passionate for developing well-crafted story-based games for the thoughtful gamer. Our nimble size allows for everyone to have a voice in our projects, demanding the ability to be both detail-oriented and flexible.

For more information about Seismic Squirrel, go to https://www.SeismicSquirrel.com/

Quests

Accounting

  • Participate with management, presenting accounting reports and advice to enable data-driven decisions
  • Create and present financial forecasts
  • Monitor and report on ROI for marketing campaigns
  • Coordinate with outside CPAs on tax compliance
  • Oversee state and provincial government registrations and filings
  • Help manage vendor relationships, setting up and maintaining billing and payment processes and systems

Bookkeeping

  • Handle QuickBooks categorization and bank reconciliation
  • Monitor accounts for funding and irregularities
  • Process sales tax, use tax, and property tax
  • Validate timesheets
  • Oversee vacation and sick time accruals
  • Sync PTO (vacation, sick time) between timesheet and payroll systems
  • Process expense reports and reimbursements
  • Administer 401(k) and Health Insurance enrollments, deductions, and payments
  • Reconcile benefit deductions from payroll with actual benefit payments
  • Keep insurance coverage up to date – e.g. Workers Compensation coverage when workers are hired, terminated, move homes
  • Ensure that team members and vendors are issued tax forms: W-2, 1099, T4, etc.

Marketing Support

  • Collect, analyze, and report on Market data
  • Evaluate the ROI of Marketing campaigns
  • Help organize and manage Marketing events

Personnel Support

  • Ensure that each contractor's contract is up-to-date
  • Administer our pool of external testers
  • Prepare and facilitate Performance Reviews
  • Administer eLearning and training compliance
  • Coordinate time-off requests: scheduling, payroll
  • Coordinate travel planning.

Recruiting Support

  • Pre-screen job applicants for follow-up review by the hiring manager and lead
  • Keep the ball rolling for hiring, scheduling interviews and providing follow-up communications to job applicants

Other Duties

  • Lead initiatives, ensuring they're effectively executed
  • Lead meetings, communicating agendas and following up on action items
  • Participate in internal game testing and feedback as needed

Character Stats

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a small-business accounting and administrative role.
  • Understands government filing and tax rules.
  • Understands employment and payroll regulations.
  • Enthusiastic for videogames and understands the videogame industry.
  • Excellent written, visual, and verbal English language communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, resourceful, able to find solutions on their own.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, able to work fast and loose or carefully with quality when each approach is needed.
  • Strong self-discipline, motivated, a self-starter with a drive for excellence.
  • Courteous and patient, able to give and receive constructive and inspirational feedback gracefully.
  • Able to work effectively within a team having a variety of roles, personalities, and backgrounds.
  • Adaptable: The job can change according to the needs at hand and requires wearing various hats.
  • Able to work remotely using various collaboration tools.
  • Proficient with QuickBooks Online.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • Passionate to learn new tools and technologies.

Bonus Points

  • Located in one of our hub metros: Seattle, Los Angeles, Austin, or Edmonton.
  • Experienced dealing with international accounting.
  • Foreign language experience.

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity for you and you're located in the Greater Seattle area, please submit both your Résumé and Cover Letter to Seismic Squirrel.

Note: Due to the many applications and our team's limited capacity to assess them, don't be surprised if we are unable to respond right away if you apply.

Salary: $36 - $46 USD per hour – Depends on skills and experience

Hello from RE Partners!

Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”

Developer Advocate

We are looking for a Developer Advocate to help developers understand, adopt, and build with Oracle AI Database.

This role is for someone who is technically credible, community-minded, and passionate about teaching. You will create demos, tutorials, videos, talks, sample applications, documentation-adjacent content, and hands-on learning experiences that show developers how to use Oracle AI Database in real-world AI and application development scenarios.

You will work closely with product management, engineering, marketing, content producers, and the wider developer community. The right person will be comfortable explaining technical topics clearly, building practical examples, speaking to developer audiences, and operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities, launches, and market conversations evolve quickly.

Key responsibilities:

  • Create developer-facing technical content for Oracle AI Database, including demos, tutorials, videos, blog posts, sample apps, code walkthroughs, workshops, talks, and hands-on guides.
  • Build practical examples that show how developers can use Oracle AI Database for AI-enabled applications, data-driven workflows, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, analytics, and modern application development.
  • Partner with product managers, engineers, and technical experts to understand product capabilities and translate them into clear developer stories.
  • Present at conferences, webinars, livestreams, meetups, workshops, customer events, and internal enablement sessions.
  • Collaborate with video producers and motion designers to create compelling developer video content, including demos, explainers, launch content, and technical walkthroughs.
  • Engage with developer communities through social media, forums, GitHub, events, feedback sessions, and community programs.
  • Identify developer pain points, common questions, adoption barriers, and content gaps, then turn those insights into practical resources.
  • Create and maintain demo repositories, scripts, sample code, technical assets, and repeatable presentation materials.
  • Support product launches and campaigns by developing credible, hands-on technical content.
  • Stay current with AI application development, databases, cloud platforms, developer tooling, open-source ecosystems, and emerging patterns in data-driven software development.

Required experience and skills:

  • Strong technical background in software development, databases, cloud platforms, data engineering, AI application development, or related areas.
  • Ability to write, explain, and present technical concepts clearly for developer audiences.
  • Hands-on experience building demos, sample applications, tutorials, or technical content.
  • Comfortable with at least one major programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, or similar.
  • Familiarity with SQL, databases, APIs, application architecture, and modern developer workflows.
  • Strong communication skills across written, video, live presentation, and conversational formats.
  • Ability to work with engineering and product teams to understand technical capabilities and represent them accurately.
  • Comfortable presenting to technical audiences and answering live questions.
  • Strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and self-direction.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities, tight deadlines, and evolving product narratives.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in developer relations, developer advocacy, technical evangelism, solutions engineering, technical product marketing, engineering, or developer education.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Database, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, enterprise data platforms, or AI database use cases.
  • Experience with AI/ML concepts, embeddings, vector search, RAG, LLM application development, data pipelines, or intelligent application architectures.
  • Experience creating technical videos, livestreams, workshops, conference talks, blog posts, documentation, GitHub repositories, or hands-on labs.
  • Existing public technical presence through speaking, writing, GitHub, open-source contributions, community engagement, or educational content.
  • Understanding of enterprise developer needs, including security, scalability, reliability, performance, governance, and integration concerns.
  • Ability to collaborate with creative teams to turn technical concepts into compelling multimedia content.

What success looks like

Success means developers can more easily understand what Oracle AI Database enables, how to get started, and how to build real applications with it. You will help turn product capabilities into practical developer experiences, credible technical stories, and content that drives awareness, adoption, and trust.

Application requirement

Candidates should provide examples of technical content, code, talks, videos, workshops, GitHub repositories, blog posts, or demos they have created. Public developer-facing work is strongly preferred, but internal technical enablement content is also relevant.

Shared expectations

Candidates should be technically curious, collaborative, resilient, and comfortable working with engineers, product managers, developer advocates, marketers, and creative teams.

A strong candidate can simplify complex ideas without losing accuracy and can operate effectively in an environment with shifting priorities and tight timelines.

Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

LATAM Payroll Manager

Veralto Corporation

Location: Mexico (Remote) – with regional travel requirements
Reporting to: Sr. Director of Global Payroll (US-based)
Function: Veralto Corporate HR – Shared Services

About Veralto:

Veralto is a global industrial technology company dedicated to safeguarding the world’s most vital resources. With approximately 17,000 associates worldwide, it provides solutions that ensure access to clean water and support the safety, traceability, and quality of essential goods.

The company operates through two main segments: Water Quality and Product Quality & Innovation, serving industries such as water, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, and industrial manufacturing.

About The Role:

Veralto is seeking an experienced LATAM Payroll Manager to lead end-to-end payroll delivery across Latin America, ensuring payroll is accurate, timely, and compliant while reinforcing consistency, reliability, and control across the region.

This role is part of Veralto’s Corporate HR Shared Services organization and plays a key role in the ongoing transformation from a decentralized payroll structure into a global payroll operating model. It is a remote position based in Mexico, reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Global Payroll, who is based in the United States, offering strong exposure to global leadership.

This role serves as the LATAM payroll subject matter expert and a key partner to Operating Company leaders, regional stakeholders, and external payroll providers. The LATAM Payroll Manager will focus on stabilizing payroll execution, strengthening coordination across countries, and building standardized ways of working, while actively shaping and evolving the payroll function over time.

This is a highly visible role that requires a self-starter mindset, comfort operating in an evolving environment, and the ability to drive transformation while ensuring day-to-day payroll continuity.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead end-to-end payroll oversight across LATAM countries, ensuring payroll is processed accurately, on time, and in compliance with country-specific requirements.

  • Own regional payroll calendar coordination, ensuring inputs, approvals, funding alignment, and deadlines are met consistently.

  • Act as the central point of coordination for regional payroll activities, including issue resolution across stakeholders and vendors.

  • Serve as escalation point for complex payroll matters and support timely resolution.

  • Review payroll outputs (gross-to-net, variances, reconciliations) before final approval.

  • Ensure payroll documentation is complete, controlled, and audit-ready.

  • Drive consistency and standardization across LATAM payroll operations.

  • Identify and implement improvements to reduce manual work, increase visibility, and mitigate risk.

  • Partner closely with HR Shared Services, Finance, and external vendors to improve data quality and execution.

  • Provide regular updates to Global Payroll leadership on status, risks, and dependencies.

Team & Scope:

  • Lead and develop a regional payroll structure that includes both direct reports and indirect resources currently operating within HR Shared Services.

  • Support the transition of payroll activities from HRSS into a dedicated global payroll model.

  • Over time, expand scope and influence as the global payroll function matures.

Job Requirements:

  • 7–10+ years of payroll experience, including multi-country LATAM payroll responsibility.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, HR, or related field.

  • Strong knowledge of LATAM payroll regulations (labor, tax, social security, statutory reporting).

  • Experience managing payroll across countries such as Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru.

  • Experience working in complex, multi-country environments and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience working with external payroll vendors and managing service delivery.

  • Strong understanding of payroll validation processes (gross-to-net, reconciliations, controls).

  • Exposure to SOX, audits, and compliance processes.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively in evolving and ambiguous environments.

  • Advanced Excel skills.

  • Fluent English and Spanish required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Portuguese is highly preferred due to regional scope (Brazil), but not mandatory.

  • Experience in global payroll or shared services environments.

  • Experience leading teams (direct or indirect) in a regional or matrix structure.

  • Experience in payroll transformations or process standardization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting organizational change or function transitions.

  • Experience with Workday, ADP, or other global payroll platforms.

Additional Details:

  • Fully remote role based in Mexico, with regional travel requirements (~25% initially, decreasing over time to ~15-20%).

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. The Ad Firm is a Digital Marketing Agency based in Southern California, serving clients nationwide. Since 2009, we’ve helped businesses grow through SEO, content, and performance-driven digital strategies.

We’re expanding our team and looking for a Senior Web Developer to lead how our websites are built from the ground up. This is not a production role. This is a systems-level engineering role for someone who understands that websites are not just design deliverables, they are performance assets that need to rank, scale, and hold up under real-world conditions.

This is a remote position with flexible working hours from day one.

About the Role

  • Own the technical foundation of the websites we build
  • Architect, develop, and optimize custom builds for SEO, performance, and scalability
  • Work closely with SEO, Content, and Digital PR teams to ensure strong technical execution
  • Build systems that are clean, scalable, and maintainable
  • Focus on engineering quality over page builders or pre-built themes

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and build fully custom WordPress websites (themes, plugins, ACF-driven structures)
  • Engineer sites for speed, scalability, and strong Core Web Vitals performance
  • Handle server environments, deployments, and infrastructure decisions
  • Integrate APIs and third-party systems cleanly and reliably
  • Own technical SEO implementation (crawlability, indexation, structured data)
  • Manage DNS, CDN (Cloudflare), SMTP, and hosting configurations
  • Work across Shopify and BigCommerce at the code level when needed
  • Implement accurate tracking (GA4, GTM) without compromising data integrity
  • Debug issues across the full stack (server, backend, frontend performance)

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of web development experience in agency or performance-driven environments
  • Deep expertise in PHP (including WordPress core-level development)
  • Strong JavaScript experience with modern frameworks and tooling
  • Working knowledge of Python (automation, scraping, tooling)
  • Proven experience building custom WordPress websites from scratch
  • Strong understanding of technical SEO and its impact on architecture and performance
  • Ability to diagnose and solve full-stack issues independently

What Sets You Apart

  • You think in systems, not pages
  • Experience working on large-scale or SEO-heavy websites
  • Strong understanding of crawlability, indexation, and internal linking at scale
  • Experience with schema and structured data implementation
  • Exposure to programmatic SEO or dynamic page generation
  • Experience handling real-world constraints (traffic spikes, broken deployments, legacy rebuilds)

Strong Advantages

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows
  • Familiarity with Docker or modern dev environments
  • Experience with log analysis and advanced debugging
  • Security hardening and site recovery experience
  • Experience with multi-site or multi-location SEO builds

What We Don’t Want

  • Heavy reliance on page builders
  • Plugin-first approaches to performance and SEO
  • Developers who need constant direction or step-by-step instructions

Why Join Us?

  • High ownership with real technical decision-making
  • Clean builds with no unnecessary bloat
  • Direct collaboration with SEO, Content, and Digital PR specialists
  • A team that values performance, scalability, and engineering quality
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
  • Flexible remote work from day one
  • 2 weeks Paid Time-Off
  • Paid Sick Leave
  • 8 Paid Holidays
  • Health Insurance

Ready to Apply?

  • Submit your resume
  • Include a portfolio with examples of custom builds
  • Add a short note on how you approach building high-performance websites
Salary: ₱60,000 - ₱80,000

Senior Product Marketing Manager (LATAM)
(Remote)

About the role

You will work with a company building a Generative Infrastructure platform that empowers developers through self-service infrastructure while maintaining governance and compliance at scale.

The platform accelerates developer velocity through automation and infrastructure-as-code, adapting to organizations at different maturity levels—from frontend teams requiring abstraction to advanced teams seeking autonomy.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic marketing. You will translate complex DevOps and cloud-native capabilities into compelling narratives that resonate with practitioners (Platform Engineers, SREs, DevOps teams) as well as executive stakeholders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering).

This is an AI-first marketing role. You will operate in a high-velocity environment leveraging AI tools to produce content, research, and insights at scale—focusing on both quality and speed beyond traditional marketing approaches.


Position: Senior Product Marketing Manager

Seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager with strong roots in the DevOps and cloud-native ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical understanding with the ability to craft clear, outcome-driven messaging and drive go-to-market strategy in an AI-first environment.


Responsibilities:

Messaging & Positioning

  • Develop clear, differentiated product messaging across customer segments (Platform Engineering, CI/CD, SRE, Observability)

  • Translate platform capabilities into outcome-driven narratives tied to real customer challenges

  • Build messaging frameworks for both technical and executive audiences (including CTOs and VPs of Engineering)

  • Create website content and marketing assets communicating differentiation and ROI

  • Quantify and communicate business impact (deployment speed, cost savings, risk reduction, scalability)

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct research on industry trends, customer pain points, and competitive positioning

  • Provide insights to influence product strategy and differentiation

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate research and competitive intelligence

Go-to-Market Strategy & Product Launches

  • Lead go-to-market strategies for product launches

  • Drive adoption through market-aligned strategies and customer narratives

  • Develop persona-specific content for different audience levels

Sales Enablement

  • Develop sales collateral (pitch decks, battle cards, ROI calculators, case studies)

  • Partner with sales to refine messaging across the customer journey

  • Enable sales teams to engage both technical and executive audiences

AI-Powered Content Creation

  • Produce whitepapers, case studies, technical guides, blog posts, and campaign assets

  • Operate within an AI-first content workflow (ideation, drafting, refinement)

  • Simplify complex technical concepts for both technical and business audiences


Requirements:

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Strong experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud-native ecosystems

  • Deep familiarity with IaC tools (Terraform, OpenTofu, Helm), Kubernetes, and CI/CD architectures

  • Understanding of SRE practices (incident management, error budgets, runbooks) and observability (metrics, logs, traces)

  • Ability to evaluate technical content for accuracy and relevance

  • Comfortable engaging with engineers, architects, and senior technical leaders

AI-First Mindset

  • Experience working with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) for content creation and research

  • Ability to integrate AI into scalable content workflows

  • Focus on output quality and speed using AI

Strategic & Analytical Skills

  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business impact narratives

  • Experience quantifying ROI and building business cases

  • Experience in market research and GTM strategy development

Collaboration & Execution

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales teams

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects

  • Ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background as a DevOps practitioner, platform engineer, SRE, or technical marketer

  • Experience working with Platform Engineering, SRE, or Observability teams

  • Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and CMS tools

  • Experience in cloud-native, IaC, Kubernetes, or CI/CD environments


About us:

The company is building a next-generation platform in the DevOps and cloud-native space, enabling organizations to scale infrastructure through automation while maintaining governance and control.

If you are passionate about shaping how complex technical platforms are positioned in the market—and want to operate in an AI-first marketing environment—this role offers the opportunity to define messaging, drive adoption, and influence how a category evolves.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the narrative of an innovative product category

  • High-impact role working closely with product and engineering

  • AI-first marketing environment

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Flexible work environment

raw.excerpt: About UJV Who Are We?  Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail.
raw.description:
About UJV

Who Are We?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?

  • UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.
  • We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.
  • We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.
  • We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity
  • and attention to detail.
  • We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.

Role Mission

As Europe Product Coordinator, you own the operational layer that keeps UJV's European hotel and ground portfolio live, accurate, and growing. That means contract renewals, rate grid integrity, partner onboarding, and hands-on support for the PD Manager — without needing to be managed. You bring real knowledge of the European travel landscape: the hotels, the DMCs, the wholesalers. You're equally comfortable in Excel and on a vendor call. If you need a task list to stay productive, this role is not for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Regional Coordination: Serve as the day-to-day operational contact for European hotel and ground partners. Manage partner and internal sales interactions, ensuring product accuracy and issue resolution without bottlenecking the PD Manager.
  • Hotel & Destination Onboarding: Lead the administrative and operational onboarding of new hotel properties into the UJV portfolio. Assist in launching new European destinations by coordinating contracts, rates, descriptions, and media assets.
  • Ground Services Expansion: Support the growth of curated ground services — including private tours, transfers, and bespoke experiences. Source and evaluate providers in coordination with the PD Manager, with an eye toward quality-to-margin fit.
  • Rate Grid & SR Maintenance: Own CSV and Excel rate grid management for ground product. Maintain system records (SR) for both hotel and ground, ensuring pricing accuracy across all booking and operational platforms.
  • Contract Renewal Management: Coordinate year-over-year renewal of hotel and ground agreements in collaboration with the PD Manager. Track expiry timelines, initiate renewal conversations proactively, and ensure executed agreements are filed and reflected in systems.
  • Competitive Price Shops: Conduct targeted price benchmarking against competing wholesalers and OTAs as needed. Deliver clean, actionable data to the PD Manager to support rate strategy and negotiation.
  • Admin, Reporting & File Organization: Generate reports, maintain organized file structures, and manage Asana task queues for ground operations. Support ad hoc projects, contract reviews, FAM trip logistics, and webinar coordination as required.

Core Competencies

  • Experience: 1–3 years in a B2B travel environment — wholesale, DMC, or tour operator. Enough to know how the industry works without needing the fundamentals explained.
  • European Product Knowledge: Working familiarity with luxury European hotels, DMCs, and ground operators across key destinations. Ability to evaluate product quality and portfolio fit.
  • B2B Travel Operations: Hands-on understanding of wholesale travel mechanics — contracts, allocations, rate grids, and overrides. Not theoretical; you've worked in these systems.
  • Rate & Data Management: Proficiency in Excel and CSV-based rate structures. Clean, accurate data management under volume and deadline pressure.
  • Partner Communication: Comfortable leading vendor calls, handling partner queries, and resolving issues without escalation. Professional and direct tone.
  • Organised Execution: Strong follow-through across multi-stream workloads. Uses tools like Asana effectively; nothing falls through the cracks.

    What Success Looks Like

At 90 Days:

  • All active hotel and ground rate grids are accurate, complete, and filed correctly.
  • You have independently handled partner calls and resolved operational queries without escalation.
  • Asana ground task queues are managed with zero overdue items.
  • You know the active European portfolio well enough to field basic product questions from the sales team.

At 6 Months:

  • Annual contract renewals are in progress or completed ahead of schedule, with no lapses.
  • At least one new hotel or ground operator is onboarded through your coordination.
  • The PD Manager relies on you to own the operational layer — she is focused on strategy, not chasing data.
  • You have contributed meaningfully to at least one FAM or webinar execution.

Who This Role Is Not For

  • Candidates who treat data entry as beneath them — this role requires precision and volume.
  • Anyone without working knowledge of European hotel tiers, DMC structures, or wholesale pricing mechanics.
  • People who need clear task lists to function — this role rewards initiative over instruction.
  • Those who prefer to work purely in the background — you will be on calls with partners and must represent UJV credibly.
  • Candidates who haven't worked in a travel trade or B2B travel environment; the learning curve without that foundation is too steep for this role.

Candidates located outside the United States will be engaged under an independent contractor agreement. You will be responsible for managing your own social security and taxes in accordance with the regulations of your home country. Please take this into consideration before applying.

829's Programmatic Account Director is a senior individual contributor responsible for the hands-on execution, optimization, and performance delivery of a multi-million dollar programmatic media investment for a single enterprise account.

This role serves as the in-platform authority across DSPs, owning campaign setup, audience deployment, inventory strategy, and real-time optimization across display, video, native, CTV, and audio environments.

You will partner closely with the Director, acting as the executional engine behind programmatic strategy, ensuring flawless activation, efficient spend, and measurable business impact at scale

What You'll Do

Campaign Execution & Ownership

  • Own end-to-end campaign execution across DSPs (DV360, StackAdapt, TTD, etc.)

  • Build, launch, and QA campaigns across display, video, CTV, native, and audio

  • Maintain scalable campaign structures (IOs, line items, naming conventions) with strict accuracy

Inventory & Deal Management

  • Activate and optimize across open exchange, PMP, preferred, and programmatic guaranteed deals

  • Manage deal IDs and publisher relationships to unlock premium inventory

  • Drive supply path optimization (SPO) to improve efficiency and transparency

Audience Activation

  • Deploy and optimize 1P, 3P, and contextual audiences

  • Execute audience layering, exclusions, and segmentation strategies

Budget Management & Pacing

  • Manage multi-million dollar budgets with precise daily pacing and allocation

  • Adjust bids, budgets, and tactics in real time to hit performance and delivery targets

  • Proactively identify and mitigate pacing risks

Optimization & Performance

  • Optimize bidding, inventory, audiences, and creative to improve CPA, ROAS, and efficiency

  • Manage frequency, reach, and duplication—especially across CTV and video

  • Identify performance drivers and scale high-impact tactics

CTV & Video Execution

  • Lead execution across CTV and OLV, including inventory selection and deal activation

  • Optimize for completion rate, viewability, and reach—not just clicks

  • Manage cross-channel frequency and audience overlap

Tracking & Measurement

  • Ensure accurate pixel implementation, event tracking, and attribution alignment

  • Support incrementality testing, lift studies, and advanced measurement initiatives

  • Troubleshoot discrepancies and maintain data integrity

Testing & Experimentation

  • Execute structured test plans across inventory, audiences, creative, and bidding strategies

  • Scale winning tactics and eliminate underperformers

  • Document and apply learnings to improve future performance

Insights & Collaboration

  • Analyze performance data to deliver actionable insights and optimization recommendations

  • Partner with strategists, creative, and analytics teams to drive integrated execution

  • Contribute to reporting with a focus on performance drivers and next actions

What You'll Bring

  • Experience: 5-8+ years in digital media planning and buying, with deep expertise in both site-direct and programmatic environments

  • Platform Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with DSPs (StackAdapt, DV360, Basis, StackAdapt, TTD), Ad Servers (Campaign Manager), and Web Analytics (GA4).

  • Channel Fluency: Proven track record managing diverse media types, including OTT/CTV, Streaming Audio, and Traditional Linear/Radio.

  • Advanced Tactics: Expert knowledge of remarketing and advanced targeting (dynamic creative, CRM, lookalike, and predictive modeling)

  • Strategic Vision: Ability to map data partners to the customer journey—activating contextual signals for awareness and deterministic identity for conversion

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation skills, with the ability to tell a compelling story through data for high-growth performance accounts.

Benefits and Perks We Provide

  • Remote Workplace. You have the option to work at our office in Boston or remotely in one of these states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IL, KY, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, SC, OH, OK, PA, RI, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA.

  • Paid Time Off. Receive generous paid vacation benefits that increase each year you’re with us, 14 Company Holidays, and Summer Fridays from Memorial Day through Labor Day.

  • 401K + Match. 401K plan with 4% Safe Harbor employer match after one year of employment and financial literacy services provided through our retirement provider.

  • Life Insurance Benefit. No-cost coverage to ensure peace of mind for your family.

  • Short Term Disability Benefit. We've got you covered if you need to be OOO with an illness or injury that keeps you out of work.

  • Healthcare. Choose from several competitive healthcare plans for you and your family with 80% employer coverage for all medical and dental premiums, 100% employer coverage for vision, and the option to participate in the FSA program.

  • Commuter Benefits. Allocate pre-tax funds towards your commute to save up to 40% per year in transportation expenses.

  • Continuing Education. Access to monthly team-led webinars, exclusive 829-cohort based learning, digital course platforms, and funding opportunities to attend national conferences and events.

What We Believe

At 829 Studios, we boldly embrace diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Our goal: a team rich in backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. Why? Because inclusivity powers our brilliance and client success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, creed, color, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, mental illness, age, ancestry, genetic information, military service, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Who We Are

829 Studios is a Boston-based integrated digital marketing agency with a mission to propel organizations to unlock their full potential and accomplish their most ambitious goals. We harness the power of logic with magic – a balance of data-driven strategy and brand-focused creative. We partner with diverse organizations across various industries and our client list encompasses venture-backed start-ups, publicly traded companies, non-profits, and more. By committing not only to our growth as a company, but the development of our employees and teams’, we have created a collaborative environment that fosters ingenuity and promotes diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging values within our community. 829 has been recognized as one of the nation’s top agencies by the Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Privately Held Companies, Adweek 100 Fastest-Growing Digital Agencies, Boston Business Journal's Fast 50 (Massachusetts' 50 Fastest-Growing Private Companies), HubSpot's Top Digital Agencies list, and a we are and employee-certified Great Place to Work.

Salary Range: $85,000-$115,000

We determine compensation based on experience, demonstrated skills, and current market conditions at the time of hire to ensure fairness and consistency across roles. Actual compensation will depend on experience and may be adjusted based on skills, qualifications, and alignment with the scope and impact of the role.

Compensation Range: $85K - $115K

We are a global OSINT company headquartered in the US, empowering investigators, compliance teams, and security professionals with cutting-edge AI-powered products. Our technology collects and analyzes massive volumes of data from 500+ open sources: social media, messengers, blockchains, and the dark web, to support data-driven investigations and decision-making.

Our customers include law enforcement agencies and enterprise organizations across 80+ countries. Social Links is scaling rapidly with the ambition of becoming a unicorn valued at $1B+.

We are looking for a QA Engineer with DevOps skills to join our engineering team. You will own test coverage across installation, integration, and performance working hands-on with Linux environments, Docker, and Python automation to keep a complex, high-stakes product reliable in production.

Your Tasks Will Be

  • Testing application installation and updates across VMs, bare-metal, and multiple Linux distributions
  • Debugging and verifying installation scripts
  • Developing and executing integration and performance tests in Python
  • Performing manual testing of REST APIs
  • Managing Docker containers: logging, restarts, configuration
  • Using Linux CLI for diagnostics, logging, and test environment setup
  • Working with NoSQL and SQL databases via CLI: MongoDB, Elasticsearch, MySQL, PostgreSQL
  • Setting up and managing local and virtualized test environments
  • Automating testing via scripting and CI/CD pipelines

What We're Looking For

  • Linux and Bash scripting: strong hands-on experience
  • Docker: confident container management in real workflows
  • Python: integration testing as a core practice
  • Django: ability to work with QuerySets, execute management commands, and inspect backend code to diagnose issues and validate system behavior.
  • API testing: both manual and automated
  • NoSQL databases: practical experience with MongoDB or Elasticsearch
  • Solid understanding of test design principles
  • English – intermediate level or higher
  • Russian – advanced level or higher

Nice to Have

  • Basic DevOps experience: CI/CD, environment provisioning

What We Offer

  • Remote-first setup: work from anywhere in the world (excluding Russia and Belarus)
  • Real ownership from day one: your work directly affects product reliability for law enforcement and enterprise customers in 80+ countries
  • A collaborative team with a startup spirit and a clear path to grow
  • Work on a technically challenging, fast-growing product at the intersection of OSINT, AI, and cyber intelligence

    We are an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment for all candidates.

Job Description Summary

‎

CareMore Health, a Mosaic Health company, is seeking an experienced Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Lead to serve as a key finance partner supporting financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision-making. This role leads complex financial analyses, owns critical planning processes, and provides actionable insights to operational and clinical stakeholders within a value-based healthcare environment.

The FP&A Lead operates with minimal supervision, serves as a recognized subject matter expert in financial planning and analysis, and leads cross-functional initiatives that improve financial performance and decision-making. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, healthcare finance expertise, and the ability to translate complex financial data into meaningful business recommendations.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Analysis

  • Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and monthly financial planning activities for assigned business areas.
  • Develop and maintain complex financial models supporting operational, clinical, and strategic initiatives.
  • Analyze financial performance, key business drivers, and emerging trends to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Support long-range planning activities through scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis.
  • Recommend improvements to forecasting methodologies and planning processes.

Business Partnership & Decision Support

  • Serve as a trusted finance partner to operational, clinical, and functional leaders.
  • Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Lead monthly variance analysis and communicate performance drivers to leadership.
  • Provide financial guidance for business initiatives, investments, and operational improvement efforts.
  • Present financial findings and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders.

Healthcare Finance & Performance Management

  • Analyze healthcare-specific financial and operational metrics, including PMPM, utilization, medical cost trends, MLR, and membership performance.
  • Support financial modeling and performance monitoring for value-based care arrangements, capitation agreements, and shared savings programs.
  • Partner with Accounting, Actuarial, Clinical, and Operations teams to understand performance drivers and improve forecasting accuracy.

Process Improvement & Project Leadership

  • Lead complex FP&A projects requiring cross-functional collaboration and independent problem-solving.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, forecasting accuracy, and data quality.
  • Support automation initiatives and implementation of planning and reporting tools.
  • Establish and maintain documentation, model governance, and reporting standards within the FP&A function.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide guidance, coaching, and technical support to analysts and other finance team members.
  • Review analytical work products and help elevate team capabilities and best practices.
  • Lead project teams and coordinate efforts across multiple stakeholders to achieve business objectives.

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive FP&A, corporate finance, or healthcare finance experience.
  • Healthcare industry experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex financial analyses, planning processes, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience partnering with senior functional leaders and influencing business decisions through data-driven recommendations.

Technical & Functional Expertise

  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Experience with planning systems such as Workday Adaptive Planning, Oracle, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency working with large financial and operational datasets.
  • Knowledge of healthcare finance concepts including PMPM, MLR, IBNR, RAF/HCC, and value-based care economics preferred.

Leadership Competencies

  • Recognized subject matter expertise in FP&A and financial analysis.
  • Ability to independently lead complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound business judgment.
  • Proven ability to coach and mentor finance professionals.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across functions.

Paid Ads Expert (App Install Focus) – Contract (Remote) Fully Remote | Flexible Hours | Project-Based Engagement

About This Opportunity
We're looking for a contract Paid Ads Expert to help us scale user acquisition for ScrollToll — a fitness app that blocks addictive apps like Instagram and TikTok until users complete physical exercises like push-ups or squats.
The app just launched on Android. iOS is launching imminently. We need someone who understands paid acquisition at the campaign level — not just boosting posts or managing budgets on autopilot.
This is a hands-on contract role. You'll run experiments, read the data, and help us figure out what actually drives installs and conversions for this product.

What You'll Do

  • Set up and manage App Promotion campaigns across Meta Ads and other relevant platforms
  • Track installs, attribution, and conversion events — and flag when data looks off
  • Run structured audience and creative tests to identify what works
  • Scale winning campaigns and cut what isn't performing
  • Monitor the metrics that actually matter for app growth — installs, CPI, ROAS, retention signals
  • Make informed decisions on when to kill a campaign versus let it run

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience running app install campaigns — mobile apps preferred, but strong e-commerce or lead gen experience is considered
  • Deep familiarity with Meta Ads, including App Promotion campaign setup and optimization
  • Understanding of the difference between optimizing for clicks, installs, and purchases — and when each matters
  • Comfortable with attribution tracking and diagnosing data discrepancies
  • Ability to stretch a limited budget into measurable results through structured testing

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with TikTok Ads or Google App Campaigns
  • Familiarity with mobile attribution tools like AppsFlyer or Adjust
  • Experience scaling an app from zero or near-zero install volume
  • Understanding of creative performance patterns for fitness, productivity, or utility apps

Professional Maturity

  • Results-oriented — you measure success in installs and conversions, not activity and reports
  • Comfortable working with a lean budget and making every rupee count
  • Able to communicate clearly what you're testing, why, and what you're seeing
  • Proactive in flagging issues and proposing next steps without waiting to be asked

Work Environment
Remote First — Work from wherever you're most productive.
Flexible Hours — Availability between 6pm and 12am PKT is required for team overlap and collaboration.
Direct Collaboration — You'll work closely with the product and growth team, with short feedback loops and quick decision-making.

Why Work With Us

  • A real product with a live user base and clear growth potential — not a demo or side project
  • Lean team, fast decisions, and no bureaucracy
  • Ownership over your work — you run the experiments and see the results directly
  • Strong contract performance leads to extended engagement as the product scales

About UJV

Who Are We?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?

  • UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.
  • We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.
  • We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.
  • We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity
  • and attention to detail.
  • We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.

Role Mission

We are seeking a skilledFull Stack Engineerwith a strong background in travel tech, particularly in online booking engines, group travel, and eCommerce. In this role, you’ll optimize critical systems for UJV, including CRM systems, pipeline management, and Book of Business Management, to improve operational efficiency and enhance client experiences. You'll work on building scalable applications with a tech stack that includes PHP, Laravel, MySQL, and modern JavaScript frameworks, in an agile, fast-paced environment where we ship daily with an emphasis on usability and performance.

You Will:

  • Design, develop and maintain features across the full stack: React/Next.js, NestJS middleware, and PHP Laravel services (Admin, Payments, SSO, Product Vault).
  • Contribute to the migration of the legacy Node.js API Gateway (AWS Lambda) to the new NestJS-based platform with Redis and message queues.
  • Define and implement scalable architecture patterns for both backend services and frontend components.
  • Integrate and leverage AI-powered tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate development and support internal workflows.
  • Collaborate proactively in a remote-first environment: communicate blockers, document decisions, participate in technical discussions.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure as code.
  • Apply travel/hospitality domain knowledge to inform product decisions, data models, and integrations.
  • Support UX/UI discussions where technical constraints intersect with user experience.

This Job is for You If:

  • You thrive in afast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and meeting deadlines.
  • You have5-7 yearsof experience in full-stack development, with expertise intravel tech(online booking engines, group travel, eCommerce).
  • You’re passionate about building scalable systems that support business operations and deliver reliable user experiences.
  • You have strong experience developing and maintaining modular PHP Laravel applications, including hands-on experience with Livewire and Filament.
  • You are experienced integrating external hotel availability suppliers such as HBSI, Expedia, or similar travel industry APIs.
  • You have strong knowledge of MySQL, including writing migrations, optimizing query performance, and managing relational databases.
  • You are comfortable working with Docker-based local development environments and contributing to infrastructure and deployment workflows.
  • You have experience with AWS services such as ECS, RDS, S3, and deployment pipelines.
  • You are experienced designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs.
  • You write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code using tools such as Pest and/or PHPUnit to ensure code quality and reliability.
  • You are confident diagnosing and resolving production incidents, system failures, and performance issues while minimizing downtime.
  • You can support frontend development work using React and Tailwind CSS.
  • You are proficient with Git/GitHub, including commits, branches, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows.
  • You have experience with agile development practices, debugging, testing, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • You’re a curious learner who enjoys improving systems, exploring new technologies, and contributing ideas and best practices.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience in the travel, hospitality, or hotel booking industry.
  • Experience working with third-party supplier integrations and availability systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Experience working in high-availability production environments.

LatAm-based candidates are welcome to apply.

Candidates located outside the United States will be engaged under an independent contractor agreement. You will be responsible for managing your own social security and taxes in accordance with the regulations of your home country. Please take this into consideration before applying.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We’re looking for a Demand Generation Manager who will own the execution of multi-channel campaigns that drive awareness, pipeline, and revenue. You’ll design and launch integrated programs across webinars, email, paid channels, content syndication, and more. All focused on reaching enterprise buyers and supporting sales with high-quality opportunities.

You’ll be equally comfortable in strategy and execution, able to take campaigns from initial concept through launch, measurement, and optimization. You’ll also play a key role in developing and refining account-based marketing (ABM) programs that engage priority accounts across key segments and influence buying committees across the enterprise healthcare landscape.

This is a highly cross-functional role collaborating closely with sales, growth, and product marketing to create campaigns that resonate with complex buying committees, addressing their key pain points and priorities throughout the enterprise and strategic sales cycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and execute full-funnel demand generation campaigns across email, paid media, webinars, and events, leveraging AI tools for audience segmentation, creative personalization, and optimal channel spend to drive engagement and pipeline growth.

  • Develop campaign briefs, timelines, and project plans, ensuring smooth, on-time delivery with clear ownership and accountability.

  • Partner closely with sales to understand their goals, buyer personas, and pipeline needs — then translate that into scalable campaign enablement and follow-up programs, utilizing AI-driven tools for sales enablement content.

  • Collaborate with content and product marketing to develop messaging and assets that speak directly to enterprise audiences and complex buying committees.

  • Manage campaign performance metrics and optimize programs based on insights, grounding decisions in real-world data to inform strategy and drive continuous improvement.

  • Own marketing-to-sales handoff processes and ensure campaign outputs are actionable and measurable, implementing automation for lead routing and progression tracking.

What You’ll Bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in demand generation, campaign marketing, or growth marketing, ideally within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

  • Proven ability to plan, execute, and measure multi-channel campaigns that drive pipeline and revenue impact.

  • Strong project management and ownership skills — you can manage complex, multi-channel programs from kickoff to results, ensuring alignment, accountability, and flawless execution.

  • Deep familiarity with enterprise sales cycles, buying committees, and the content/messaging needed to influence them.

  • Experience partnering with sales and marketing operations to align campaign strategies with business goals.

  • Analytical mindset with experience using tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar to measure campaign success.

  • Experience using AI as a force-multiplier for demand generation efforts—speeding research, insights, and content iteration—while preserving brand voice and accuracy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you can craft compelling messaging and articulate strategy clearly across teams.

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be within commutable distance of our New York City, San Francisco, or Chicago locations and must be willing to be in the office Tuesday - Wednesday - Thursday.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We provide reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. If you need reasonable accommodation in applying, interviewing, completing any assessment or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us at accommodations@abridge.com

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

raw.description:
Coverflex

Work changed. Pay didn’t.

Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.
Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel.
We turn compensation into choice - one platform, one card, one app - for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more.

Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees.
We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment.

⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials)

Role: AI Engineer
Seniority Level: Mid
Type: Individual Contributor
Languages: English (main) / Portuguese, Spanish or Italian a plus
Main Tools:

→ OpenAI API

→ Vercel SDK or similar

→ Langsmith / Braintrust / Langfuse or similar

→ Cursor / Codex / Claude Code

Location: Remote (Europe only)
Compensation:

  • Base Salary: 40K to 60K gross annually

  • Equity: Yes – VSOPs

  • Benefits: See below

  • Contract Type:Permanent

💥 Your Impact

Your role will play a major role in our success because…

With our goals to scale AI, specially for expansion post-series B, we need AI that has some minimum threshold of reliability. Our AI already handles thousands of conversations per week and we expect that to increase significantly. We need dedicated effort in making sure that our AI is accurate, helpful and reliable.


You’ll know you’re successful when, after 90 days, you’ve…

1. Maintain evals to keep close to 100% accuracy and update them as we get new feedback

2. Monitor user feedback to ensure our agents have a high level of accuracy

3. Run new experiments to proactively increase the performance of current agents (test new prompts, models, agent architectures)

4. Keep up to date with AI developments

5. Design new agents

6. Maintain Evals infrastructure to run reliably and at reasonable time and cost in our CI/CD pipeline

How we’ll measure success:

1. Eval coverage exists for all production agents. Evals are updated shortly after new feedback. Accuracy stays above agreed threshold and matches real-world performance.

2. Feedback loop is active - issues are caught and logged. Time to detect accuracy problems decreases. Recurring issues are identified and addressed.

3. Number of experiments ran and documented per month, resulting in improvements shipped to production.

4. New agents go from concept to production. Agents meet quality bar on first iterations (fewer back-and-forth cycles).

⚡ Reality Check - What Makes This Role Hard

Let's be real - here's what makes this role challenging:

Biggest hurdle is the fact that this is a new field. Processes are being created and it requires faster adaptation to new developments in the industry. Also relevant is that we LLMs are inherently non-deterministic which can make the work more complex than with software.

👤 You

Must-haves (evidence, not years)

→ Functional coding in TypeScript or Python

→ Demonstrated experience with LLMs (personal project or professional)

→ Experience with creating AI agents

→ Familiarity with LLM providers and model trade-offs

Nice-to-have

→ Exposure to LLM observability tools

→ Experience with OSS models

→ Background in SW, product, QA, or data

🧬 Your DNA

Genuinely curious about AI — explores new models and tools for fun, not just work. More excited about making the model perform well than writing elegant code. Comfortable with ambiguity and iteration. Testing mindset: likes to measure, compare, and improve. Proactive in sharing findings and documenting learnings.

Who will probably find this frustrating…

Someone who sees this as a stepping stone to "real" ML/infra engineering. Pure coders who want to build systems but have no patience for prompt iteration. People who need clear specs to start working — this role requires experimentation. Anyone who thinks prompt engineering is "not real work".

👥 Manager & Team

Meet Your Manager

Hiring Manager: Fábio Domingues, Senior AI Engineer
Location: Portugal
LinkedIn Profile:https://www.linkedin.com/in/fjrdomingues/

Profile Snapshot:

  • Energy:Calm and steady. I genuinely enjoy the work — solving problems, making progress, seeing things improve. No artificial urgency or drama. I like to keep things relaxed while still moving forward.

  • Communication: Straightforward and low-ceremony. I value clarity over polish. I might skip the small talk and get straight to the point — not because I don't care, just because that's how I'm wired. I'm always open to questions and back-and-forth.

  • Feedback Style:Honest and collaborative. If something isn't working, I'll say it — but constructively, and I'll help fix it. I appreciate direct feedback in return. No egos, no politics

How to work with me - in the Manager's own words:

Relaxed but engaged. We'll share the workload, think through problems together, and iterate quickly. I don't have rigid processes — you'll have room to shape how we work. If you like autonomy, ownership, and a calm environment where the focus is on doing good work, we'll get along well.

Your Team

You’ll work day-to-day with:

  • Engineers, Product Manager, Product Designer, Engineering Manager

Key Stakeholders:

  • Bruno Oliveira, VP Engineering

  • João Caxaria, Head of AI

  • Vitor Pires, AI Engineer

  • Jorge Mestre, AI Engineer

💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity)

We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree.
We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.

No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, gender, sexual orientation, or any other protected ground.

Assessment fairness:
We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).
We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).

📬 Application Clarity

No cover letter required.

Apply with your LinkedIn or upload your CV.
You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.

Total candidate time investment: ~3–5 hours end-to-end.

🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long)

1. CV / LinkedIn Screen — Signal check vs must-haves
• You’ll hear from us within 7 business days.

2. Hiring Manager Interview - Engineering Mindset deep-dive • 45–60 min\

3. Cultural Interview -With People • 30 to 45min

4. Case / Work Sample - Walkthrough + Q&A • 60 to 90 min
You’ll get actionable feedback either way.

5. Final Conversation (CEO / C-Level) — Values, strategy, and your growth • 30–45 min

Optional: References (2–3 people who’ve seen your recent work) - async.

⏱️ Speed & Communication

  • Decision: within 4 weeks of your application.

  • Updates: weekly if the process runs longer.

  • Scheduling:interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).

  • Feedback:from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback - what went well, and what to strengthen next time.
