SambaNova Suite™ is the first full-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on-premises or in the cloud, combined with state-of-the-art open-source models that can be easily and securely fine-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.

Overview

The Senior Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the production-grade inference infrastructure that powers SambaNova's serving stack on our Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU) architecture. SambaNova is an inference-first company, and this role sits at the heart of that mission: turning state-of-the-art inference techniques into reliable, high-throughput, low-latency services exposed to customers through SambaStack and SambaCloud. The engineer will own end-to-end systems spanning request scheduling, advanced decoding algorithms, caching layers, API surfaces, and the accuracy infrastructure that keeps the stack trustworthy. This role partners closely with ML, compiler, runtime, and product teams to ship inference features from prototype to production.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of industry experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, ideally in ML serving
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design
  • Experience designing and maintaining production services with strict latency, throughput, and availability requirements
  • Working knowledge of modern LLM inference techniques and familiarity with open-source serving stacks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or SGLang
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Experience collaborating across teams to deliver complex, system-level engineering solutions

Key responsibilities

  • Design and productionize advanced inference techniques on RDU to optimize for performance and cost. Key areas include speculative decoding, constrained decoding, function/tool calling, prompt caching, and long-context inference.
  • Own SambaNova's integration with vLLM and adjacent serving frameworks, adapting them to RDU's architecture.
  • Own the public inference API surface exposed through SambaStack and SambaCloud.
  • Build and maintain the accuracy verification and regression infrastructure that gates every inference feature shipped to customers.
  • Partner with ML, compiler, runtime, and product teams to take inference features from prototype to production.

raw.title: Business Design Lead
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Business Design Lead to join our team.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Business Design Lead to join our team. At Runyon, Business Designers drive the analysis of the viability of products and ventures, and articulate how optimal business models shape the experience, and vice versa. They consider a series of monetization opportunities, operational considerations as well as the growth implications to scale into market while maintaining a firm understanding of the underlying market dynamics of incumbent position, emergent players and value exchange across key stakeholders in the ecosystem.

This role requires someone who is highly strategic, detail-oriented, and experienced in financial modeling, performing competitive analyses, creating growth strategies and testing value hypotheses and growth hypotheses from low to increasing live fidelity. They have the ability to develop a deep understanding of a partner’s business and translate those into a plan of action. They develop strong relationships and build trust with core decision-makers, both internally and externally.

About Runyon

Runyon is a product design and venture studio that helps companies grow. We are a team of customer-centered designers, researchers, and strategists that crafts new products, experiences and ventures. Our approach combines customer needs and behaviors with leading edge business strategy. Our work is sprint- and prototype-driven and we think about how we can craft strategies and products into the market in ways that are meaningful and measured from the start. Our team has decades of experience working with some of the largest global partners including Disney, The New York Times, American Express, Target and others.

  • We're prototyping-led. We lead with tangible assumptions in the form of prototypes and test them with real stakeholders to validate and refine our strategy and design. Regardless of discipline, we think and communicate in concepts, and use those to move further, faster.
  • We're detailed and intentional. We always back up our design decisions with sound reasoning—be it user research, market research, or both. We make things that make sense and that have a clear through line.
  • We're fast. We work almost exclusively in sprints, and with lean teams. We need folks who like to run.
  • We're collaborative. We jam as a multidisciplinary team of specialists who collectively contribute to the full spectrum of work across user research, strategy and design to arrive at high quality outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Active participation in ideation sessions with project team to concept new experiences, services and features that can ladder up to a new, differentiated offering in the market
  • Coordinate team members and collaborate with partner stakeholders to define strategic success criteria and business or venture objectives
  • Design profitable new products, brands, and services, as well as new business models and ventures
  • Shape growth and go-to-market strategies for those new products and ventures
  • Craft design-driven market and competitive analyses that inspire and position our partners in differentiation ways
  • Craft financial models that establish what needs to be true for revenue growth, as well as product and venture success
  • Shape operational resource plans that inform key strategic hires and financial planning
  • Develop and lead experiments, producing insights that help identify and craft strategic roadmaps
  • Establish deep partnerships with cross-functional team members, ensuring collaborative progress toward key product milestones

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience as a business designer, business strategist, or business analyst at a design studio, consultancy, or internally within an organization
  • Fluent in business acumen, including knowledge in strategy, marketing, finance, operations and product development
  • Ability to build and interpret financial models to quantify business impact
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex business ideas to different audiences, in addition to listening and modifying your thinking based on the contributions and perspectives of others
  • Ability to easily adapt, and switch between different projects, businesses and industries
  • A desire to engage with collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams which include our partners
  • A proven track record of successfully launched products as a business designer, product manager, product growth strategist, and/or as a startup founder
  • Great communication and time management abilities, including the skill to direct and manage small teams and judiciously involve investors, experts, and stakeholders
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and have a propensity to experiment with generative ideas in order to identify the most innovative and disruptive solutions

Please note that this job posting remains active as part of our ongoing effort to build a network of talented designers, strategists, researchers, and other creative professionals. As a result, it may not correspond to an immediate opening. Runyon’s dynamic, fast-paced environment makes this ideal for candidates who thrive in flexible, project-based roles.

Salary: $750 - $1,300 / day based on experience and skill level

raw.description:
The Opportunity

We’re a growing engineering consulting firm solving complex challenges across the built environment and infrastructure. Our growth is intentional, strategic, and powered by exceptional talent. Talent isn’t a support function here, it’s a competitive advantage.

We’re seeking a Technical Recruiter who thrives in growth environments and is energized by proactive recruiting. This role is ideal for someone who loves the hunt: building pipelines before roles are urgent, engaging passive talent in competitive markets, and serving as a trusted recruiting advisor to business leaders.

You’ll operate as a strategic partner within a matrixed organization, collaborating closely with hiring managers, HR, and business leaders, often providing market intelligence, talent insights, and recruiting guidance that shape hiring decisions. Your work will directly influence our ability to scale high-performing teams and deliver meaningful engineering solutions to our clients.

This is a high-impact role for a recruiter who wants ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to grow alongside a firm that truly values talent.

What You’ll Do

  • Proactively source and engage technical talent (engineering, design, project management, and specialized technical roles) using LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, industry networks, associations, and targeted market research.
  • Build and maintain forward-looking talent pipelines aligned to priority skill sets, geographies, and long-term business needs.
  • Design and execute high-quality outreach strategies, including personalized messaging and nurture campaigns that resonate with passive candidates.
  • Deliver strong, well-vetted candidate slates by assessing technical alignment, motivation, and cultural fit while preparing candidates for a successful interview experience.
  • Partner with hiring managers and HR leaders on role intake, profile calibration, and interview alignment to ensure efficient, focused searches.
  • Serve as a talent advisor, providing market insights, compensation trends, availability data, and recruiting recommendations to hiring leaders and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage the candidate experience end-to-end with clear communication, timely updates, and a high-touch, relationship-driven approach.
  • Track and analyze pipeline metrics (sourcing activity, response rates, funnel conversion, slate quality) and adjust strategies to continuously improve outcomes.
  • Maintain strong process discipline in the ATS, ensuring accurate documentation, compliance, and coordination with recruiting and HR partners.

What We’re Looking For (Required Experience/Skills)

  • Minimum of 5 years of technical recruiting experience, ideally within engineering consulting, AEC, or similarly complex technical industries.
  • Proven experience recruiting in matrixed organizations, successfully balancing multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • Demonstrated success partnering directly with internal or external clients, providing talent insights, market intelligence, and recruiting guidance.
  • Strong sourcing expertise and comfort engaging passive, hard-to-find technical talent.
  • Ability to translate complex technical requirements into effective sourcing strategies and compelling candidate outreach.
  • High ownership, persistence, and accountability; comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong candidate-first mindset.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Meaningful impact: You’ll directly influence the growth of teams delivering critical engineering and infrastructure solutions.
  • Room to innovate: Bring new sourcing ideas, tools, and approaches to life in a collaborative environment.
  • People-first culture: We value relationships, transparency, and exceptional candidate experiences.
  • Competitive rewards: Strong compensation, a robust 401k match, and comprehensive employee benefits designed to support your long-term success.
  • Growth with stability: Join a firm that’s growing intentionally and investing in both its people and its future.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Salas O’Brien provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, or local laws. Salas O’Brien will accommodate the disability-related needs of applicants as required by law

Third-Party Agency Notice
Salas O’Brien does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters or agencies. We only work with approved partners engaged directly by our Talent Acquisition team for specific searches. Unsolicited submissions will not be eligible for placement fees.

Compensation Range: $75,000- $85,000

raw.description:
The Director of Programmatic & Media Buying is a senior strategic leader responsible for driving client success, media planning excellence, and operational performance across the agency’s Programmatic Media practice. This role serves as the primary programmatic subject matter expert, ensuring that client strategies, media plans, and campaign execution consistently deliver measurable business outcomes while meeting the agency’s standards for quality, innovation, and service excellence.

Working closely with Client Services and Marketing teams, this role leads strategic planning for key client accounts, elevates programmatic capabilities across the organization, and establishes best practices that drive consistent performance and operational efficiency. This individual plays a critical role in supporting client retention and growth by providing senior-level consultation, thought leadership, and strategic guidance across Display, Video, CTV, Audio, Native, and emerging programmatic channels.

The Director of Media Buying also leads and mentors a team of programmatic professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional development. While partnering with agency leadership on service evolution, staffing, and operational priorities, this role is primarily focused on ensuring exceptional client outcomes, scalable delivery processes, and best-in-class programmatic planning and execution.

What You'll Do

Client Success & Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as senior strategic lead across key enterprise programmatic relationships.

  • Guide annual, quarterly, and campaign-level media planning to ensure plans align with client business objectives.

  • Provide executive-level consultation on audience strategy, channel mix, measurement frameworks, and budget allocation.

  • Partner with Client Services leadership to support retention, growth, and overall client satisfaction.

  • Lead escalations, performance reviews, and strategic recommendations for high-priority accounts.

  • Ensure programmatic strategies are integrated with broader marketing initiatives.

Media Planning Excellence

  • Establish and uphold best practices for programmatic planning across Display, Video, CTV, Audio, Native, and emerging channels.

  • Review and elevate media plans, audience strategies, testing frameworks, and measurement approaches.

  • Drive consistency in planning methodologies, forecasting, and performance evaluation.

  • Ensure planning recommendations are grounded in data, business objectives, and market opportunities.

  • Act as a senior reviewer and quality assurance lead for major programmatic initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Team Leadership

  • Lead day-to-day operational health of the programmatic team.

  • Drive workflow efficiency, delivery consistency, quality standards, and process improvements.Partner with department leadership on capacity planning, staffing recommendations, and resource allocation.

  • Coach and mentor Associate Directors, Strategists, and Media Buyers.

  • Support onboarding, training, and development initiatives to strengthen team capabilities.

  • Ensure operational processes support both client success and scalable growth.

Innovation & Practice Development

  • Identify emerging technologies, platforms, and opportunities that enhance client performance.

  • Partner with executive leadership on evolving programmatic offerings, positioning, and go-to-market strategies.

  • Champion adoption of new capabilities, measurement approaches, and planning methodologies.

  • Represent the agency as a thought leader internally and externally when appropriate.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of digital media buying and programmatic advertising experience.

  • 5+ years leading teams, departments, or agency service lines.

  • Extensive expertise managing multimillion-dollar media investments across programmatic channels.

  • Proven experience leading enterprise-level client relationships.

  • Strong understanding of agency operations, resource management, and financial performance.

  • Experience owning departmental budgets, forecasting, and profitability targets.

  • Deep experience across Demand Side Platforms (StackAdapt, DV360, TTD, etc.), Ad Servers (Campaign Manager), Web Analytics (Google Analytics), and MTA/MMMs.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentational skills

  • Exceptional time management and organization skills

  • Knowledge of remarketing and advanced targeting tactics, including dynamic creative, CRM, site retargeting, search retargeting, keyword contextual, affinity, look-a-like, predictive, etc.

Benefits and Perks We Provide

  • Remote Workplace. You have the option to work at our office in Boston or remotely in one of these states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IL, KY, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, SC, OH, OK, PA, RI, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA.

  • Paid Time Off. Receive generous paid vacation benefits that increase each year you’re with us, 14 Company Holidays, and Summer Fridays from Memorial Day through Labor Day.

  • 401K + Match. 401K plan with 4% Safe Harbor employer match after one year of employment and financial literacy services provided through our retirement provider.

  • Life Insurance Benefit. No-cost coverage to ensure peace of mind for your family.

  • Short Term Disability Benefit. We've got you covered if you need to be OOO with an illness or injury that keeps you out of work.

  • Healthcare. Choose from several competitive healthcare plans for you and your family with 80% employer coverage for all medical and dental premiums, 100% employer coverage for vision, and the option to participate in the FSA program.

  • Commuter Benefits. Allocate pre-tax funds towards your commute to save up to 40% per year in transportation expenses.

  • Continuing Education. Access to monthly team-led webinars, exclusive 829-cohort based learning, digital course platforms, and funding opportunities to attend national conferences and events.

What We Believe

At 829 Studios, we boldly embrace diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Our goal: a team rich in backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. Why? Because inclusivity powers our brilliance and client success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, creed, color, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, mental illness, age, ancestry, genetic information, military service, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Who We Are

829 Studios is a Boston-based integrated digital marketing agency with a mission to propel organizations to unlock their full potential and accomplish their most ambitious goals. We harness the power of logic with magic – a balance of data-driven strategy and brand-focused creative. We partner with diverse organizations across various industries and our client list encompasses venture-backed start-ups, publicly traded companies, non-profits, and more. By committing not only to our growth as a company, but the development of our employees and teams’, we have created a collaborative environment that fosters ingenuity and promotes diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging values within our community. 829 has been recognized as one of the nation’s top agencies by the Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Privately Held Companies, Adweek 100 Fastest-Growing Digital Agencies, Boston Business Journal's Fast 50 (Massachusetts' 50 Fastest-Growing Private Companies), HubSpot's Top Digital Agencies list, and a we are and employee-certified Great Place to Work.

Salary Range: $120,000-$150,000

Actual compensation will depend on experience and may be adjusted based on skills, qualifications, and alignment with the scope and impact of the role.

Northeast Volleyball Club (NEVBC)

Travel Operations Manager

Position Summary

The Travel Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing all travel and lodging logistics for Northeast Volleyball Club's teams, coaches, and families. This role serves as the primary point of contact for tournament housing, coach travel, travel-related communication, and travel budget oversight, ensuring that all travel requirements are met while providing a positive and efficient experience for coaches and families.

The Travel Operations Manager serves as a trusted resource for families and coaches, helping navigate travel requirements while providing exceptional customer service and maintaining strong relationships with tournament housing partners, hotels, and event organizers.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and takes ownership of projects from start to finish. They are comfortable making decisions independently, anticipating issues before they arise, communicating frequently and clearly with their manager and Program Directors, and finding solutions with minimal oversight while managing multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Tournament Travel Management

  • Oversee all aspects of travel planning and execution.
  • Secure and manage hotel room blocks for parents and coordinate accommodations for coaches of over 35 NEVBC girls and boys club teams.
  • Ensure compliance with stay-to-play requirements.
  • Work with tournament housing companies, hotels, and event organizers to meet the club's travel needs.
  • Support families by providing access to room blocks and ensuring that housing obligations are fulfilled.

Travel Website Management

  • Maintain and consistently update and check the NEVBC Travel web page
  • Ensure that tournament information, booking links, deadlines, travel instructions, and other resources remain accurate and up to date throughout the season.

Parent Communication & Support

  • Serve as the primary resource for travel-related questions and communicate regularly with families regarding booking deadlines, room blocks, and travel updates.
  • Provide timely support and solutions when travel-related issues arise.

Coach Travel Coordination

  • Work closely with Program Directors to keep tournament schedules and coach attendance information up to date.
  • Coordinate all coach travel arrangements across programs (over 35 teams), including hotel accommodations, flights, and other transportation when necessary.
  • Assist with staffing logistics by tracking coaching assignments and ensuring appropriate travel accommodations are secured.

Budget & Financial Management

  • Monitor travel budgets and track expenses.
  • Process coach stipends and expense reimbursements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • At the conclusion of each season, provide travel and budget summaries to club leadership and contribute to planning for future seasons.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain up to date travel records, contracts, confirmations, and other documentation.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of travel policies and procedures that support the club's continued growth and operational success.

Qualifications

  • Extremely strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and spreadsheet management.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with club leadership.
  • Strong customer service skills and ability to work effectively with families, coaches, vendors, hotels, and tournament organizers.
  • Ability to remain calm, responsive, and solution-oriented when managing last-minute travel changes or unexpected issues.
  • Previous experience in event planning, travel coordination, hospitality, or sports management is preferred.

Communication & Availability Expectations

  • Respond to emails and travel-related communications within 48 hours, with same-day responses preferred whenever possible during peak travel periods.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and responsiveness when interacting with families, coaches, tournament organizers, hotels, and club leadership.
  • Proactively communicate deadlines, updates, and potential issues before they become problems.
  • Important: While the majority of work can be completed during flexible weekday hours, occasional evening and weekend availability is required to address urgent travel matters, including tournament check-in issues, hotel concerns, flight delays or cancellations, travel rebooking, housing compliance matters, and other time-sensitive situations that may arise during tournament weekends.

Time Commitment & Compensation

This is a year-round, fully remote, hourly position with flexible scheduling. Workload for this position fluctuates throughout the year based on the club's tournament and travel calendar. On average, the position requires approximately 10-15 hours per week, though actual hours may vary depending on the time of year and can go up to 20-25 hours during peak weeks.

Peak activity occurs between October and June, with increased workload during major booking periods, tournament scheduling windows, and travel-heavy portions of the season. Some weeks may require fewer hours, while others may require additional time to support travel demands and tournament schedules.

Compensation is based on actual hours worked. This position is not salaried and does not guarantee a fixed number of hours each week.

Success in This Role

Successful candidates will:

  • Communicate proactively and professionally with directors, families, coaches, hotels, and tournament organizers.
  • Anticipate potential travel issues before they impact teams.
  • Maintain highly organized systems and records.
  • Balance customer service with managing club and tournament travel policies and requirements.
  • Remain calm and solution-oriented when unexpected issues arise.
  • Take ownership of travel operations while collaborating closely with club leadership.

Reporting Structure

The Travel Operations Manager reports directly to the Club Director and works closely with Program Directors, coaches, tournament organizers, housing companies, hotels, and NEVBC families.

Impact on NEVBC

The Travel Operations Manager plays an important role in helping NEVBC athletes, families, and coaches have a positive travel experience throughout the season. By managing the countless details behind tournament travel, this position allows our teams to focus on what matters most: competing, developing, and representing Northeast Volleyball Club at the highest level.

Salary: Hourly, rate may vary based on experience level

We’re looking to hire a Sales Representative within the next 2–3 weeks. If you’re a fit, expect a quick and efficient interview process (steps listed below).

If you’re looking for a six-figure consultative sales role with uncapped commission, warm leads, and real impact—you just found it.

At Prep For Success Tutors, our sales reps don’t cold call—they consult with pre-qualified, warm leads to help their clients reach their law school dreams. You’ll sell a proven tutoring service (with over 300 5-star reviews on Google) with a 50%+ close rate, backed by a team of 170+ LSAT scorers.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Conduct 1-on-1 Google Meet sales calls with prospective clients (that are warm leads - not cold calling) to sell tutoring services.
  • Most sales are a one call close; however, follow-up might be necessary for select clients to ensure the sale.
  • Collect payment from clients for tutoring services.
  • Once lead becomes a client, match them with a tutor to continue with fulfillment.

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • Confidence and strong self-assuredness to succeed in meeting new customers and making a sale.
  • Mental endurance. A Sales Representatives will be meeting with many prospective clients, hear some rejection, and will have to continue to push through.
  • Entrepreneurial and competitive spirit to maximize profits and maximize their own commission.
  • Strong ability to sell and negotiate with confidence and a winning attitude.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to recognize and prioritize profitable opportunities.

What you can earn:

  • Top performers take advantage of our uncapped commission structure. Prep For Success has the ability to give our top sales representatives as many clients/accounts as they wish.
  • Our current sales account managers salaries range from $90,000 to $110,000 which is comprised of a $50,000 base salary (paid weekly) and uncapped commission (paid monthly).

What hours you'll work:

  • Hours are 2pm to 11pm EST Tuesday-Saturday (with Sunday & Monday off) with midday break for lunch. However, there is the ability to work additional hours per week as Prep For Success can provide more sales calls to make more commission.

What we bring to the table:

  • Don't like commuting to work and getting stuck in traffic? No worries! This is a completely remote position with no in-person component.
  • Expensive suits? Don't need those! We want you to be comfortable yet professional, so sweatpants and a polo is just fine.
  • Unlimited compensation due to uncapped commission structure.
  • We’ll fill your calendar with pre-qualified, warm leads—no cold calling or prospecting required. Our current team closes 50%+ of calls.
  • Your own personal setter! She will be responsible for filling your calendar and managing reschedules and no-shows. You do NOT need to hunt for your own leads.
  • We hire you for sales and only sales! Once the sale is made, our tutors, client success team, and customer support will handle the rest.
  • Ability to grow with a fast-paced startup. Sales development and career path – 100% of sales leadership promoted from within.

What is the application and training process:

We’re looking to hire our next sales rep within the next 2–3 weeks, so if you’re a fit, expect a quick and efficient interview process.

  • Fill Out This Application
  • 1st Round Interview: a brief 15 minute live interview via google meet to assess qualifications and expectations.
  • 2nd Round Interview: a 45 minute call where you will perform a mock sales call that you will prepare for based on a recording of one of our sales call.
  • 3rd Round Interview: a brief 30 minute meeting with additional members of the team.
  • Then you will receive an offer letter, onboarding materials, and steps for your first day!
  • Training will start which will consist of watching game tapes, sitting in on live sales calls, conducting mock sales calls with feedback, and learning about our scripts, SOPS, KPIs, etc. This will approximately be the first month, and your first official call will be approximately 2-4 weeks into the position.

If you’re ready to close deals, change lives, and earn six figures, apply now. 😊

IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

You will have the opportunity to not only solve immediate customer issues but also to collaborate with sales and product teams to enhance the customer experience and help our clients maximize the value they get from our services.

You are analytic, have a technical background, and love the challenge of digging into problems. You are driven, have no problem multitasking, and get inspired by being part of a team and company under development.

This role is open to candidates located in the Philippines, Malaysia, or China.

Job Responsibilities

Customer support & Incident Management

  • Identify, manage, and resolve complex customer issues, responding to technical inquiries and fulfilling service requests with a high degree of ownership.

Service Quality & Routing Management

Operational Excellence & Automation

  • Develop and maintain critical operational tools, including traffic dashboards, system alarms, and procedural runbooks.
  • Analyze daily performance data to proactively identify, investigate, and resolve potential service-impacting issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for automation and increased operational efficiency to elevate service delivery standards.

Who are you?

At your core, you are a curious and analytical thinker who genuinely enjoys the challenge of a technical investigation. You have a positive, "can-do" attitude and find real satisfaction in not just solving a problem, but in seeing a customer thrive because of your help. For you, being part of a global team isn't just a job detail—it's an opportunity. You are excited by the idea of working with colleagues from all over the world and believe that different perspectives are key to personal and professional growth. 

Qualifications

  • Must be fluent in Mandarin
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical customer support or service delivery role (2nd line or higher preferred).
  • Background in the telecommunications industry, with strong, practical knowledge of SIP protocol and modern voice technologies.
  • Proven experience working with APIs, including the ability to use or build simple libraries/scripts for testing and troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting large, complex data sets to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and drive decisions.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • A quick learner, capable of adapting to new technologies and processes efficiently.
  • Flexible and willing to work occasional non-standard hours to support a global team and customer base.

What we promise to give you

  • Birthday leave (day off on your birthday)
  • Additional vacation leave as outlined in the employee handbook
  • Health insurance coverage
  • Home internet allowance
  • Access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Sinch Values

• Dream Big - We make the impossible possible by dreaming big to solve our customers’ problems and improve their businesses. Great things happen when we dare to challenge the status quo and find creative new ways to wow them. Driven by curiosity, we believe there is no such thing as failure, only continuous learning, and development. Having big, crazy, ambitious goals drives our success.

• Win Together - Great teams work faster and better together – creating meaningful impact for customers. Together as one global team, in close collaboration with our customers, we embrace diversity, meritocracy and care about every single individual. We build trust through open and honest relationships. It’s all about the team: being inclusive, respectful, and sharing our knowledge to empower all for personal growth. We collaborate, have fun and are stronger together.

• Keep it Simple - Sinch means simple and easy. It’s how we want customers to feel when dealing with us: uncomplicated, down-to-earth, and useful. Things stay simple when you are honest, open and act with integrity. Cut the fluff and talk straight! This also means spending our time and money wisely on things that really count. Eyes on the horizon, feet on the ground.

We stay accountable for our actions, apply the highest ethical standards to set ourselves apart and always deliver. If we’re not making an impact, we rethink the approach. Structure helps us, bureaucracy and excuses do not. No putting things off – let’s get it done now.

raw.excerpt: Who we are Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform.
raw.description:
Who we are

Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform. Capacity provides everything you need to automate support and business processes in one powerful omni-channel platform.

We believe that each individual voice, perspective and background brings inherent value to enhance our product, serve our customers and generate more ideas to solve complex problems. By continuing to hire talented, driven and humble teammates, we have the opportunity to see Capacity become a premier brand enterprise SaaS platform.

Capacity has raised over $100 million dollars from over 150 investors, giving us the opportunity to make ambitious investments in our team and big bets on our future. Our total addressable market is enormous. Any company that wants to grow revenue, reduce costs, and improve customer and employee satisfaction is an opportunity for Capacity to shine.

Why this job is exciting

The role:

We are looking for an experienced software-as-a-service (SaaS) security practitioner to join our growing Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team. This role will primarily take ownership of our security hardening standards and our Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing on proactive improvements in cybersecurity, ensuring audit readiness, and scaling GRC processes through automation.

This is a high-impact role suited to someone who wants to influence cybersecurity at scale, enjoys working cross-functionally, and is able to balance strong risk management with commercial pragmatism.

You will work closely with operational stakeholders across the organization, helping strengthen our overall security posture, including vendor assurance, while enabling the business to move safely and quickly.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the following:

Security Hardening & Technical GRC

  • Provide hands-on support in the assessment, improvement, and maintenance of technical security baselines based on industry best practices (e.g., NIST, CIS, ISO). You will ensure these configurations satisfy global regulatory mandates (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
  • Leverage automated tools to monitor security and compliance posture.
  • Act as a GRC interface with Infrastructure and Engineering teams to ensure hardening requirements are technically feasible and effectively implemented.

Third-Party Risk Management

  • Manage and continuously improve the company’s Third-Party Risk Management programme across suppliers, vendors and strategic partners.
  • Own end-to-end due diligence processes for new and existing vendors, including inherent risk assessments, security/privacy reviews and ongoing monitoring.
  • Review vendor assurance documentation such as ISO 27001 certificates, SOC 2 reports, penetration test summaries, policies and compliance evidence.
  • Identify, document and communicate vendor risks, remediation actions and approval recommendations.
  • Maintain risk tiering and reassessment schedules for critical and high-risk vendors.
  • Act as a trusted partner to internal stakeholders during vendor onboarding, renewals and procurement decisions.
  • Engage directly with suppliers to resolve due diligence issues and drive remediation.

GRC Operations & Improvement

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation within GRC systems.
  • Support team members as necessary with global and contractual compliance efforts, as well as internal and external audits.
  • Contribute to security and compliance policy, process, and control improvements.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and improved GRC tooling.

What success looks like in the first 12 months:

  • Strong audit readiness with high-quality, reliable technical evidence.
  • Effective use of GRC tooling to automate and streamline compliance processes.
  • Mature and efficient Third-Party Risk Management workflows.
  • Improved turnaround times for vendor assessments and internal requests.
  • Clear visibility of cybersecurity control effectiveness and risk posture.
  • Reduced manual effort through automation and improved processes.

Requirements:

Essential

  • 3+ years’ experience in compliance, GRC, vendor risk management, information security, internal audit or related fields.
  • Proven experience in cybersecurity and managing third-party/vendor due diligence programmes.
  • Strong understanding of common assurance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST or equivalent.
  • Good working knowledge of UK GDPR / privacy considerations in supplier relationships.
  • Familiarity with cloud/SaaS environments and common systems (e.g. identity providers, cloud platforms, collaboration tools).
  • Experience reviewing supplier security documentation and identifying practical risks.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proficient in English.

Desirable

  • SaaS / software industry experience.
  • Experience in a multi-entity or fast-growth business environment.
  • Familiarity with Vanta or other GRC tools.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISM, CRISC, CIPM, CIPP/E).

You are motivated by:

  • Hustle: You inspire others to work as hard as you. You will find a way, no matter how hard the task is.
  • Ownership: You have an owner/builder mentality. You care about what you deliver and own your mistakes.
  • Proactivity: You don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do or what problems to solve. You are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Excellence: You set a high bar and surpass expectations. You hit your goals and ask for more.
  • Humility: You are not above any task in the organization and are willing to drop what you’re doing to help a teammate.

What you can expect from us

The team:

Capacity team members enjoy the opportunity and benefits of working at an artificial intelligence startup, but with leaders who’ve worked at places like Apple, Ebay, Visa, Answers.com, Oracle, Boeing, and many more world-class companies. The culture at Capacity encourages innovation, independent problem solving, and collaboration as we continue to mature our product in the ever-changing world of AI.

We provide:

  • Private health insurance
  • Profit Interest Unit Appreciation Rights
  • 25 days paid leave
  • Pension
  • Group life assurance
  • Group income protection
  • Flexible work environment
  • A supportive, diverse workplace where we prioritize respect for each other and our clients
  • A fun and collaborative team culture

Salary range:

  • The expected base salary for the Technical GRC Specialist role is between £50,000 and £65,000; actual salary will be commensurate with a candidate's experience, skill and location.

Still unsure?

At Capacity we value more than just hard skills. Our goal is to build a holistic and diverse team. If you aren’t sure if you qualify, just apply! We will carefully consider your application and are always grateful for any time and effort invested in Capacity.

But wait, there’s more!

At Capacity we believe in more than just building amazing products and helping our customers. Although we are a remote workforce, we remember the neighborhood where we started. We still strive to elevate our community by furthering access to education and careers in the tech space. Our affiliated nonprofit, Create A Loop, brings rigorous computer science courses to underserved communities with little to no access to formal computer science education. There are many opportunities for our Capacity team members to serve and educate our Create A Loop students throughout the year.

raw.title: Mental Health Therapist - District of Columbia
raw.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About The Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, NOCD, wants our Therapists to focus on what's most important – treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPC, LMFT, LICSW) in District of Columbia to join our network.
We will provide the training necessary to become a specialized therapist and ensure you are fully equipped to deliver effective, evidence-based treatment.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • District of Columbia: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT) preferred
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in District of Columbia = $70,000 - $97,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401(k) match, and paid parental leave for eligible employees
  • PTO based on an accrual system
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Specialized ERP training with experienced OCD providers
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases

This role collaborates with project managers and other functional leads to deliver clinical and start-up activities within budget and contract, ensuring quality, compliance and meeting country-specific commitments.

The role generally works under the direction of a (Senior) Clinical Trial Manager, however, may also work independently at a lower complexity study.

  • Ensure start-up and clinical project plans address identified risks while adhering to professional standards, SOPs, client, and regulatory requirements.

  • Proactively identify and address start-up and clinical project, financial, and quality risks by applying comprehensive risk management strategies and ensuring compliance, including tracking within applicable systems.

  • Lead the end-to-end process of regulatory/ethics committee submissions, approvals, and tracking.

  • Ensure clinical and ancillary supplies -including import/export logistics and supply destruction processes- are in place as applicable.

  • Manage operational aspects to support subject recruitment and retention, patient safety, vendor performance, and the monitoring visit strategy.

  • Proactive planning for monitoring activities to ensure data integrity, patient safety and endpoint protection.

  • Ensure inspection-readiness through quality oversight of TMF, monitoring reports, protocol deviations and issue management.

  • Oversight and approval of site payments, including payment reconciliation.

  • Foster effective communication and collaboration with clients and cross-functional project teams in a global and multicultural environment.

  • Provide feedback on team members as needed to respective line managers.

  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

  • University/college degree (life science preferred) or certification in a related allied health profession (nursing, medical, or laboratory technology) from an appropriately accredited institution.

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Four or more years of relevant clinical research experience in pharmaceutical, CRO, or health care setting will be considered.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of GCP, ICH, and regulatory guidelines.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with EDC, CTMS, eTMF, and vendor platforms (e.g. Veeva Vault, Medidata).

  • Effective leadership in remote and global environment.

  • Strong communication, planning, and organizational abilities.

  • Proven team motivational skills.

  • Proficiency in balancing concurrent tasks within time-sensitive environments.

  • Financial awareness and use of tracking systems/tools.

  • Demonstrated independent problem-solving and risk management mindset.

  • Demonstrated professional client interaction and presentation skills, with ability to work independently and collaboratively.

In this role, employees will leverage their existing experience and skills to assume additional responsibilities within the broader role. These will be aligned with operational requirements and internal training, without altering the fundamental nature or classification of the position.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Master’s or other advanced degree.

  • PMP certification or equivalent.

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

  • Remote-based work required with possible office presence depending on location.

  • Travel requirements: up to 20% (global – primarily domestic and international)

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About the Role

We are looking for an IT Specialist to join our IT department and work closely alongside our IT Administrator. This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who thrives in a small team environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow into a key pillar of the company's technology operations.

You will support day-to-day IT operations, assist with infrastructure management, and play a meaningful role in building out our data infrastructure — contributing to dashboards, pipelines, and analytics tooling that the wider business relies on. Over time, this person will develop the capability to manage IT operations independently and serve as backup coverage for the IT Administrator.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn fast, or a mid-level candidate who already has solid foundational skills and wants broader ownership.

Schedule is 8 hours/day, 8am to 5pm, Eastern Time, Mondays to Fridays.

Key Responsibilities

Helpdesk & End-User Support
  • Serve as a first point of contact for internal IT support requests from employees
  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues in a timely and professional manner
  • Manage and maintain IT ticketing and support workflows
  • Provide excellent customer service — communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical staff

Infrastructure & Systems
  • Assist in the administration and maintenance of Microsoft 365 and Azure environments (user provisioning, licensing, security policies, Entra ID)
  • Support on-prem and cloud-based systems, including patching, monitoring, and maintenance
  • Help manage and maintain network infrastructure, including switches, firewalls, and VPNs
  • Assist with backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint management processes

Data Infrastructure & Analytics
  • Support the build-out of a modern data stack, including data pipelines and a centralized data warehouse
  • Assist with administration and maintenance of Metabase and Grafana for internal reporting and dashboards
  • Help develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to centralize data from various business tools
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to build and maintain dashboards and reports that support decision-making
  • Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of data tooling (e.g., data warehouse platforms, transformation layers such as dbt)

Documentation & Process
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of systems, configurations, processes, and procedures
  • Assist in creating run-books and internal knowledge base articles
  • Help identify gaps in existing IT processes and propose improvements

Growth & Collaboration
  • Work closely with the IT Administrator to learn all aspects of the IT environment
  • Over time, develop the skills and knowledge to manage IT operations independently and act as backup coverage
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other departments to understand their technology needs

About the IT Department

Our IT department is a lean, high-impact team currently run by a single IT Administrator. We manage the full breadth of technology operations for the company — from end-user support and systems administration through to data infrastructure and analytics tooling. This new hire will be a foundational addition to the team, with real opportunity to shape how IT grows alongside the business.


Requirements

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in an IT support, systems administration, or similar technical role
  • Solid troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, networking, and end-user hardware/software issues
  • Comfortable working in a small team with significant autonomy and breadth of responsibility
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Detail-oriented with a habit of keeping documentation accurate and up to date
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with a genuine service mindset toward internal employees

Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID / Azure AD)
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on Azure, AWS, or GCP (VMs, storage, networking)
  • Familiarity with Metabase or Grafana for dashboards and reporting
  • Exposure to data pipelines, ETL/ELT concepts, or a modern data stack (e.g., data warehouses like Snowflake or BigQuery, transformation tools like dbt)
  • Experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar)
  • Experience with no-code or low-code platforms (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, Make, Airtable) or app development (internal tools, web apps, or integrations)
  • Any relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, CompTIA A+/Network+, Azure/AWS/GCP fundamentals)
